newsitem.title: INDIA: Asahi India Safety up 10 pct on bonus.
newsitem.headline: Asahi India Safety up 10 pct on bonus.

text.p: Shares of Asahi India Safety Glass surged 111.75 rupees, or nearly 10 percent to 1,231.75, on Monday, hitting a daily price-limit at the Bombay exchange on news that the firm will consider a bonus share issue today, dealer said.
The Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in a notice said the board of Asahi India will meet later on Monday for an issue of bonus shares.
The company's shares have jumped 19 percent this month ahead of bonus expectations.
